## Selected poster presentations

- **Strings and Geometry 2026, Uppsala:** Quantum Kähler obstructions to
  \(\mathcal{N}=1\) infinite-distance limits.
- **Strings and Geometry 2024, Hamburg:** Complexity of the flux landscape.
- **Strings and Geometry 2022, Utrecht:** Asymptotic Hodge theory and deformed WZW
  models; gong show and poster presentation.

## Academic service and organisation

- **2025–present — String Theory Seminar, University of Hamburg and DESY:**  
  Co-organiser of the weekly seminar series.
- **Peer review:** Referee for the *Journal of High Energy Physics*.
- **2021–2023 — Alumni Talks, Utrecht University:**  
  Co-organiser of a recurring seminar series in which alumni of the theoretical-physics
  MSc and PhD programmes presented career paths beyond academia.
- **2022 — Strings and Geometry, Utrecht University:**  
  Co-organiser of the workshop.

## Outreach

**Vierkant voor Wiskunde, 2016–present** — Volunteer organiser and instructor at an
annual mathematics summer camp for children aged 8–12.
